source.name: ERP Today – Oracle Red Bull Racing Partnership with Oracle Extended to Power AI-Driven F1 Performance
source.quote: Oracle and Oracle Red Bull Racing agreed to extend and expand their title partnership for several more years

note: Oracle partnered with the team from the 2021 season-opening Bahrain Grand Prix (team partner page, 25 Mar 2021). The title 'Oracle Red Bull Racing' branding followed; the multi-year extension was announced 26 February 2026 (per Oracle's linked announcement; ERP Today reported it 27 February 2026). No value reported.
